content.comment_body: What is the largest value that the AQ section of the stopwatch can display, and what occurs when this value is reached?

The answer depends on the selected time base. The highest value possible is 65,535. For example: - 65,535 * 0.01 seconds - 65,535 * 1 second - 65,535 * 1 minute - 65,535 * 1 hour When 65,535 is reached, the stopwatch stops and will not continue increasing.

analysis.insight_summary: A user asked about the maximum value the AQ section of a stopwatch can show, and another user explained that it is capped at 65,535. The stopwatch will stop counting once this value is reached, no matter the chosen time base. No errors occur, but users should be aware of this built-in limit.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect clear information on the stopwatch's maximum limit and the system's behavior when this threshold is reached.
